name: onewire-master
notes: 1-Wire bus master (Maxim AN126 operations, standard speed) on DQ pin7, open-drain; external pull-up required. TX word: bits 7..0 a byte; bit 8 set: reset and presence detect first. The byte is sent LSB first in 8 time slots that also sample DQ; RX word: the 8 sampled bits (the byte itself for a write, the slave's data when the byte is 0xFF).
Reset at 50000000 Hz: DQ low 25000 clocks (500 us); presence sampled 3500 clocks (70 us) after release; first slot 25000 clocks (500 us) after release. No presence pulse: fault 96.

Time slot at 50000000 Hz: DQ low at 0; a 1 bit releases DQ at 300 clocks (6 us); DQ sampled 700 clocks (14 us) after the fall; a 0 bit releases DQ at 3250 clocks (65 us); next slot at 3750 clocks (75 us).
DQ is released at every holding point (PULL, PUSH). The host checks CRCs. Scope: standard speed only; no overdrive, strong pull-up (parasite power) or alarm-presence handling.
